name: Jali Na Teri Jali Na
visual_description: Akshay Kumar in a hospital gown grinning mockingly and pointing his finger forward with the subtitle 'Jali na? Teri jali na?'
usage_context: Used to mock someone who is obviously jealous, irritated, or envious of your success or good fortune.

example.caption: When your colleague sees you leaving early after getting promoted

text_areas.description: Situation or setup describing someone getting jealous
